nom: d'Alba Piedmont Essence Sunscreen Broad Spectrum Chemical SPF 50+

avis.titre: Not even close to the Korean version
avis.texte: This version made specifically for the United States with the US approved filters is nothing like the original Korean version. This US version has got a mousy cottage cheese like feel when applying, it does however smooth out and sink in. I've got dry skin this did dry down in less than 10 minutes, but you could see the shin of my face from space. It did do a good job preventing sun burn, but i will not be able to use this because the United States UV filters in it caused my eyes to burn. Had to wash it off after 10 minutes.

avis.titre: I Will BUY this Product Again!  It is now my GOTO SPF.
avis.texte: d'Alba Essence Sunscreen Broad Spectrum Chemical SPF 50+ plays well with all types of foundation. This is the best under foundation sunscreen product I have ever used. It acts like a second layer of moisture. It does not lay on the skin like most sun protection product.
Got this because I forgot my sunscreen at home. Would buy again. Is smooth and non-white cast, and not sticky or smelly.

I have been lowkey lacking in the spf department and heard really good reviews on this guy , decided to try it out and im in loveee !! Leaves no white cast , leaves your skin plump and youthful! Makes your skin look glowy and healthy

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: The great thing about the product is that it is not sticky and is very light . I used it for a month now and is very effective.I received this product for free for an honest review

avis.titre: Best Sunscreen that smells great and is gentle on your face.
avis.texte: I really love this sunscreen. I am thrilled that Ulta carries this. I was ordering from an overseas carrier and paying the extra tariff because I loved this product. It smells amazing. I love that it is 50 plus sunscreen protection. My favorite brand.
I love the way this sits on the skin and doesn't leave any kind of oily residue. It applies so nicely and doesn't leave me greasy afterwards either. Would definitely recommend to others

The d'Alba UV Essence Waterfull+ broad spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen is great for everyday use. The light and creamy texture is hydrating and goes on smooth. No white cast on my darker skin. No heavy fragrance.
Light, non-greasy, applied so easily and looks great under makeup. It does not have a white hue. The ingredients are super high quality. A must have for the spring/summer.

avis.titre: FINALLY an spf that doesn't break me out
avis.texte: I love this spf so much. It has no acne triggering ingredients and isnt super heavy on the skin. I always get acne from spf but havent with this one. It is hydrating, wears really well under makeup with no pilling issues, and leaves my skin glowy. It's a new staple product for me for sure!

I would like to thank d'Alba for giving me the opportunity to try and review their Vegan Essence Suncreen. I really loved the product from the first use because it doesn't leave a white cast on my skin like other suncreens. When I applied it, I felt it is very moisturizing and worked well under my makeup. It has a light, pleasant scent and absorbs quickly. This suncreen is especially great for people with dry skin like me. I love it.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I've been really enjoying this sunscreen. It feels more like an essence than a typical spf cream and leaves my skin looking fresh and dewy without white cast. Compared to other sunscreens I've tried, this one is very light and layers nicely under makeup. I also like that its 50+ vs 30+. Feels very moisturizing. I would definitely buy it if I needed more and would recommend it to friends and who want a lightweight spf.

avis.titre: Part of my morning routine now!
avis.texte: This product is amazing. I love the way it feels, and protects.. i put it on right before my makeup. Definitely buying this from now on!

This is my first time trying out d'Alba brand of sunscreens. The milky texture is very moisturizing and glides on very nicely on my skin. I wish it was waterproof too, but this is a good everyday sunscreen that's sensitive skin friendly.
This sunscreen leaves no white cast which is usually the problem for me! Not too oily either so I can definitely layer with makeup.

To be honest, I've never heard of this brand before so I was totally open minded. The very first time I used it, I loved it. It was like that "oh wow, this is nice" moment. It's very light and smooth. A little goes a long way. There's no white cast or greasiness. And it absorbs quickly. I experimented by adding a little bit of my foundation to it in the palm of my hand, and it blended perfectly. My skin is combination. But sometimes it's drier than normal - probably due to dehydration. But either way, my skin loved this sunscreen! No breakouts, no white cast, and no waiting forever for it to absorb.

avis.titre: Amazing texture and full coverage protection
avis.texte: I have tried a number of sunscreens but they often leave a thick, pasty residue or cause my makeup to become flaky. This one went on smooth and provided the coverage I needed. I will continue to use!

I received the d'Alba Piedmont UV Essence Waterfull+ sunscreen complimentary for my honest review, and I'm honestly so impressed! This sunscreen feels super lightweight on the skin, no heavy or sticky feeling at all, which is a huge plus for everyday wear. It blends in beautifully and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth without any white cast. I love how it gives that fresh, dewy finish while still protecting my skin with SPF 50+.

I do live in California where wearing sunscreen is a must. I did use this sunscreen on vacation in Hawaii too and use it every day This sunscreen is very lightweight and very moisturizing on your face Broad spectrum 50+ did help to keep my face without any sunburn. I did apply every morning and reapply in mid-afternoon. No stingy in the eyes or any another reaction to it Love this face sunscreen

avis.titre: Finally a sunscreen that feels like a high-end moisturizer
avis.texte: I've tried so many SPFs that leave a white cast or feel like a heavy mask, but this one is a total game-changer. It has this lightweight, watery essence texture that literally sinks into the skin in seconds. It gives me that "glass skin" glow without looking greasy, and it doesn't pill under my foundation. Plus, the slight white truffle scent makes my morning routine feel a bit more like a spa session. If you hate the feeling of traditional sunscreen, give this a try

avis.titre: Loved it and would buy again.
avis.texte: Since I live in Texas a sunscreen is a must for me. I have combination skin and most formulas either leave a heavy white cast or fail to provide enough hydration. D'Alba Vegan Essence Sunscreen has the excellent texture: dense enough to hydrate, but lightweight enough to breathe. No white cast and, no immediate 'sweating' feeling after application. If you struggle with sunscreens being either too drying or too heavy, this is the one.

avis.titre: Lightweight product with a beautiful scent
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with the d'Alba Vegan Essence Sunscreen. It works very effectively and provides great protection without feeling heavy on the skin. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, which makes it perfect for daily use. One thing I particularly love is the scent. It's subtle, fresh, and adds a pleasant touch to the whole experience without being overpowering. Overall, it feels comfortable on the skin, doesn't leave a greasy residue, and keeps my skin looking healthy and hydrated. Definitely a product I would recommend!

I've been really impressed with the free sample I received of d'Alba Vegan Essence Sunscreen through BzzAgent. The lightweight texture makes it incredibly easy to apply, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or heavy feeling on the skin. It also has a pleasant, subtle scent that isn't overpowering, which makes it enjoyable to use every day. Most importantly, it provides reliable protection throughout the day without causing irritation or breakouts and leaves skin looking brighter. It layers well under makeup and keeps my skin feeling comfortable and hydrated. Overall, a fantastic vegan sunscreen that checks all the boxes.

avis.titre: Lightweight, hydrating sunscreen that gives a nice glow
avis.texte: I've been using the d'Alba UV Essence Waterfull+ and it's pretty nice overall. It feels super lightweight, more like a moisturizer, and doesn't leave a white cast. It gives a glowy, hydrated look, which I like, but might be a bit dewy for oily skin. Works well under makeup though. Not the strongest-feeling sunscreen, so I'd reapply if I'm outside a lot but good for everyday use

This product surprises me. The texture is like thick cream but not greasy at all. It makes my skin feel moisturized, and it goes well under my makeups. The color is a bit light yellow, smells like fresh orange. The sunscreen works well with spf 50+, even though I haven't had chance to test it in really long hours and a lot of sun exposure. For everyday use, it's perfectly fine. I would buy this product after I finish the free sample. Disclaimer: I received this product for free in exchange for writing this review. But all my review is 100% honest based on my true experience.

I have very sensitive skin, and I get dark spots from sun exposure. So a good sunscreen is a must-have item for me any day I am out. Thanks to d'Alba for the awesome Vegan Essence sunscreen I got for free for testing and review. I am hooked and will keep using it going forward. Here is what I loved after trying out d'Alba sunscreen for a few days now. First, it handles its primary purpose fine. I did not get any new dark spots on my face and had no irritation. Second, it works well with the makeup I have used along with it, with no issues. Third, it has a minimal neutral scent that doesn't conflict with my perfume. And, finally, it does feel nice on the skin. Thanks, d'Alba, for the free Sunscreen!

As someone who uses sunscreen daily throughout the year, I'm always looking for a non greasy option that won't make me break out. I have been using dAlba's Essence sunscreen for the past two weeks and I love it. The formula feels very light on my skin and does not dry greasy. It does have a white cast at first, which I actually appreciated because I could see where the sunscreen was being applied. Though the cast quickly goes away once rubbed into the skin. I also like the soft citrus scent and appreciated that it wasn't too heavy.

avis.titre: Longest lasting sunscreen I've ever used!
avis.texte: Thanks so much to d'Alba for sending me their UV Essence Waterfull+ SPF 50+ sunscreen for my honest review. I love the packaging which makes it so easy to squeeze exactly the right amount of product out. It is so smooth and silky with a very slight mandarin orange scent. The vegan cream provides amazing sun protection, and stays on through an intense workout, or outdoor activities. No sunscreen will get in your eyes, even when sweating! Apply after using your regular skincare routine, and your skin will feel hydrated and soft. I recommend this for anyone who wants luxurious UV protection without the scent of cheap sunscreens. It's my new favorite product and I've told all my coworkers and family about it.

This product is a must have! I really like the formula which feels lightweight on my skin. It also does not leave any white case at all. This sunscreen will give you a healthy glowy looking effect while protecting your skin from UVs. I highly recommend this sunscreen if you are looking for a budget friendly option with high-end result

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This has a light, citrus scent I adore. It's light yellow and blends smoothly and quickly with no white cast on me. Some sunscreens irritate my eyes or make my skin burn due to tretinoin use but this one doesn't. I will purchase this. Gorgeous sunscreen.
This is a great every day sunscreen. High SPF, easy to blend and leaves no white cast. My skin looks glowing and is protected.

This is a nice face sunscreen. It has a thick creamy texture with a lemony scent. I can still smell the classic sunscreen smell underneath the lemon. It spreads easily but takes a bit to absorb. I don't like how shiny it leaves my face.

Honestly love this sunscreen. I have issues with pilling and white cast with daily sunscreens but I didn't have any of those issues with this formula. It's hydrating, light weight, and doesn't leave my skin greasy.
I love this product because it doesn't feel like you're wearing anything! Great base for makeup too. Definitely a repeat on repeat SPF!

avis.titre: So good, I use it every day
avis.texte: Really love this sunscreen. The texture is super light and feels more like a moisturizer than SPF — no stickiness at all. It absorbs fast and leaves my skin looking fresh and hydrated. I also like that it's vegan and gentle on my skin. Works great under makeup, no pilling. Just a really good everyday sunscreen — I keep using it every morning.

What I liked the most is the texture is super lightweight and feels more like a hydrating essence than a typical sunscreen. It absorbs quickly without leaving any white cast, which is a huge plus. What I really love is how it keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day while still providing strong sun protection. It doesn't feel greasy or heavy, even in warm weather, and works beautifully under makeup. Perfect for everyday use, especially if you want something that combines skincare and sun protection in one step. Definitely a staple in my routine now!

This is a very good sunscreen. I applied to my face and feel that my skin becomes soft a hydrated. Now it is my everyday routine. I can't leave a house shout throw sunscreen. I see a little bit of glow on my face without feeling greasy. Also, this sunscreen works as a concealer. It evens the tone of my face.

I have used many sunscreens, predominantly from prestige brands, and this is the first that I can say, does not feel like a sunscreen at all. First of all, there's no sunscreen smell whatsoever, I have definitely tried other sunscreens where the scent has been minimized tremendously, but still had an underlying scent. This, absolutely does not. Additionally, even with the prestige brands, there's always some quality about the texture that feels like sunscreen, or is incredibly overly watery, but this product does not feel like that. It feels like a lightweight water-based facial moisturizer. It has definitely replaced all of my other sunscreens, and I would highly recommend it to anyone. As a matter of fact, I just bought two more to keep in my car and at the office. As for the anti-aging effects, I have not used the product long enough to say whether it does or does not impact aging. Regardless, the fact that I get the sunscreen protection without any of the sunscreen qualities is more than enough to make up for that.

I'm slightly disappointed with this one. It doesn't leave a white cast which Is great but the scent (citrus) is very off putting. It makes me feel like I'm putting a cleaning agent on my skin. Also don't understand the vegan concept of this product. What makes it vegan? Lastly, the worst part is that it made my forehead very shiny. Looks like I'm very greasy. It looks nice on my cheeks though - gives a nice dewy look. It's a shame that it doesn't do well on my forehead.

D'Alba UV essence waterfull is a quality sunscreen. It has a light scent that is very attractive. Also, it is not greasy when I apply on my skin and no residue. I would keep using this product as my sunscreen in the hot summer and everyday

Nice creamy texture. Very moisturizing. Thicker than Beauty of Joseon or Skin1004 . Evens out skin tone. May leave a bit of white cast on darker skin tones. Leaves skin glowy. Must let it completely dry and absorb before applying makeup or it will pill. Has a bit of a citrus scent. Will definitely need to double cleanse, which means that this sunscreen is thick enough to provide sun protection. This is the US version of this sunscreen and thus is thicker. The Korean version is much lighter and feels more like an essence. I have tried both.

avis.titre: Feels silky and hydrating, no white cast, but stings my eyes
avis.texte: I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review. Overall this is a nice sunscreen, I appreciate the SPF of 50, it glides on nicely, and feels silky and hydrating. It also left no white cast on me but I am in the light shade family, no pilling and played well with my skincare and makeup. After a little while my eyes did start to burn which does happen for me with chemical sunscreen vs a mineral, I did try to avoid my eye area as carefully as I could.

I am loving this sunscreen. I have dry skin and it gives the perfect amount of hydration and wears beautifully under my makeup. The consistency is light and it doesn't have a strong fragrance at all. I'm definitely adding this sunscreen to my daily routine. I'm even thinking about getting my husband his own bottle for him to start wearing daily as well

I tried the d'Alba Vegan Essence Sunscreen after d'Alba sent it to me for free so I could review it. I'm a 27 year old guy who spends a lot of time outdoors, so sunscreen is something I actually use regularly. The texture was the first thing I noticed. It feels really lightweight and smooth going on, more like a moisturizer than a typical sunscreen. It absorbs pretty quickly and didn't leave a white cast or greasy feeling, which I liked since I'm often outside and moving around. It also seemed to work well. I wore it during longer periods outside and didn't get any sunburn or irritation. Overall it feels comfortable, easy to apply, and does the job. If you want something light that still protects your skin, this one is worth trying.

This sunscreen is fantastic and feels more like a skincare product than a typical SPF. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin. It gives a nice hydrated glow without feeling greasy. I also like that it works well under makeup. Great protection and very comfortable to wear every day.

This was gifted for an honest review: I've been really impressed with the d'Alba vegan sunscreen lotion. The consistency is very smooth and lightweight, and it blends into the skin easily without feeling heavy. My makeup goes over it beautifully, no pilling at all, which is a big plus. I also appreciate the quality ingredients. Overall a really solid sunscreen and I would definitely purchase it again.

This sunscreen is in a class by itself. I previously used Supergoop, Kiehls Better screen and Black Girl Sunscreen in the past; none compare. I just admit, applying sunscreen is a habit I'm still trying to consistently reinforce in my skincare regimen. I think my previous sunscreens either left a white cast or just doesn't mesh well with my moisturizer and serums, However; the d'Alba sunscreen made my skin look so good that it is now a step I can't wait to apply. I have a medium brown skin tone with warm undertones, the d'Alba sunscreen went on so smooth and did not leave any residue. My face felt and looked perfectly hydrated, so much so that I received compliments that my skin looked smooth as "glass" I instantly have fallen in love with this sunscreen. I appreciate the added layer of moisture without 'overdewing it' I have combination skin leaning slightly to the oily side and this sunscreen layered with my moisturizer without making me greasy. I'll definitely be buying this again.

This product compares well to other high quality sunscreens. I found that this sunscreen absorbed very quickly, leaving no residue. It felt very lightweight and doesn't feel thick. My skin feels moisturized, but not greasy. The product spread very evenly. I would definitely buy this product to use on my face. I would utilize this product while going on an airplane. I would recommend this product to my friends and family because it is a very high quality sunscreen. I got this sunscreen for free in exchange for writing the review.

I normally use spf every day under my makeup, but sometimes the products don't sit well (too oily, separates, pills off, etc). This one sits SO well and provides a good base for my makeup. It gives my skin a good "dewy" base, without leaving it greasy like some other sunscreens. It's the perfect size for travel too!

Sunscreen is one product I wear every day, and I've tried so many different brands. This one is a in my top 3. It moisturizes, goes on well under my makeup and doesn't burn my eyes. I actually enjoy the bit of fragrance it has, but I'd prefer a fragrance-free option. Overall, it is a great product with a high spf that keeps my skin protected.
This stuff is amazing, it goes on smoothly and has an amazing smell, nothing like your typical spf scent more citrus. It sits well under makeup its so nice and you feel protected all day long.

I like the packaging and the light smell of the product. The smell was not overwhelming and didn't leave a scent on my face. The product went on smooth, and absorbed wonderfully into my skin. Feels luxurious on me and like a moisturizing cream, but with the benefits of sunscreen as well. This is perfect for everyday use and works well as a layering base under makeup. This product is definitely worth the price as a little goes a long way.

I've always have been super picky with the kind of sunscreen i use. Having combination i hate when chemical sunscreen is too moisturizing and some mineral sunscreen is just too drying. This texture is perfect and provides a light hydration to my skin. My skin feels moisturized with a minimal shine.

avis.titre: Great product - wish it was mineral sunscreen
avis.texte: Love the texture of the product. It leaves no white residue and absorbs immediately. It also does a great job as a base for makeup. It performed well throughout the day, leaving no oily residue or white sheen. I like mineral based sunscreen products and this did have chemical ingredients and a chemical smell.

Every time I use this I get so many compliments on how healthy my skin looks, helps hide my wrinkles a little and its very hydrating. Wears amazing under make up too! My only issue is that it irritates my eyes throughout the day. I have to be super careful not to apply it anywhere near my eyes but even then my eyes will be irritated.
